notes.title: 🎉🎮 Controller Support is Here! 🎮🎉
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198830/0135f5754d2c264122087d4e8dd8ff4c2f0bd569.png[/img]

[b]🎮 Controller Support is Here! 🎮[/b]

I'm excited to announce that [b]Pixelmancy[/b] now supports controllers! Whether you're using an Xbox, PlayStation, or other compatible controllers, you can now dive into the game with ease.

[b]What’s new?[/b]
[list] [*] Full controller support throughout the entire game. [*] Two different aim modes with adjustable sensitivity settings. [*] Full rebinding of keybindings to customize your controls.  [/list]
Thank you for your support - happy gaming! 🎉💜
